FN-AJY4QSS-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 233
Committee: Financial Services Sponsor: Representative Sorrells
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 03/05/2024
House Bill 233 as introduced would increase receipts to the State General Fund, beginning in
Fiscal Year 2026, by an undetermined amount dependent on the number of off road vehicles
required to be titled under the provisions of this bill and the payment of the $15 certificate of
title fee, provided by current law.
This bill would also increase receipts to the judges of probate or other local licensing official by
$3 for each commission fee retained by the official for issuance of a title under current law.
